headlines.name: Astronomers discover a dead star spinning every 8 minutes and sending mysterious radio pulses
headlines.headline: Astronomers discover a dead star spinning every 8 minutes and sending mysterious radio pulses
headlines.description: Scientists have discovered a strange stellar pair more than 5,000 light-years away, where a dead star spinning every eight minutes produces mysterious radio pulses while orbiting a Sun-like star. The breakthrough also revealed massive magnetic storms on the companion star, offering fresh clues to one of astronomy's emerging mysteries.

sources.description: The FAA lifted its nationwide ground stop on Friday night, but the impact will be felt on football fields Sunday.
